title: Kosh Innovations
description: koshinnovations.com zoominfo.com/c/kosh-innovations/369426368 Kosh Innovations, established in 2008 in Pondicherry, India, is a leading manufacturing solutions provider specializing in precision engineering, plastic moulding, sheet metal components, and electronic manufacturing services (EMS). Certified with IATF 16949 and multiple ISO standards, the company serves diverse sectors including automotive, consumer durables, green-tech, and healthcare. With a strategic presence across six locations in India, Kosh Innovations is committed to delivering customized, sustainable, and high-quality products through a customer-centric and innovative approach
